hold_duration.dependency: Exact maximum needs event close/resolution provider data.
hold_duration.reason: Rejects impossible durations without inventing venue rules.
hold_duration.recommended_range: Use hours or days unless a known event close is available.

latency_budget.dependency: Exact latency policy belongs to later runtime stages.

max_budget.dependency: Exact maximum needs account/cash provider, which this UI PR cannot read.
max_budget.reason: Budget must be positive and remains local preview.
max_budget.recommended_range: Start small until provider receipts and account limits exist.

max_loss.dependency: Max budget must be entered first.
max_loss.reason: Loss cannot exceed budget in local preview.
max_loss.recommended_range: Less than or equal to max budget.

max_spread.dependency: Exact spread constraints require venue/provider artifacts.
max_spread.recommended_range: Depends on venue tick and liquidity.

portfolio_exposure.reason: Local UI rejects impossible percentages only.
portfolio_exposure.recommended_range: Provider-pending until account exposure is available.

stop_exit_threshold.dependency: Venue tick and exit rule authority are provider-pending.
stop_exit_threshold.recommended_range: Keep in the same unit as target price/probability.

target_price_probability.dependency: Venue tick and price unit are provider-pending unless an accepted artifact supplies them.
